title: Students ticking boxes, taking steps toward semiconductor workforce
summary_en: Seven students from across Iowa spent six weeks of their summer learning to design, build and test their own microelectronic devices. Iowa State's semiconductor workshop is part of a year-long effort to help build a workforce that understands semiconductors and AI hardware.
title_cn: Students ticking boxes, taking steps toward semiconductor workforce

title: Finding what it takes to make a white blood cell could lead to new cancer treatment
summary_en: An Iowa State University-led research team identified two essential components — a pervasive protein and a crucial cellular signaling pathway — needed to make some types of blood cells, a discovery that could lead to a new treatment for leukemia.
title_cn: Finding what it takes to make a white blood cell could lead to new cancer treatment

title: Several Iowa State research projects selected for U.S. Department of Energy Genesis Mission
summary_en: Iowa State University is the lead institution in four research projects and university faculty are collaborators on four additional projects that are part of the U.S. Department of Energy’s sweeping Genesis Mission. The awards were announced July 22 in Washington D.C.
title_cn: Several Iowa State research projects selected for U.S. Department of Energy Genesis Mission
